# Winters Code

> Custom websites and apps for Oregon coast small businesses. React, Astro, and Flutter on a modern stack, with no templates and no WordPress. One person designs, builds, deploys, and maintains every project. Help is just a text away.

Winters Code is the software shop of Preston Winters in Bandon, Oregon. It builds custom marketing websites, web apps, and mobile apps for small businesses across Coos County, Curry County, and the wider Oregon coast. Every build runs on a modern engineering stack (React, Astro, Flutter, Supabase, Cloudflare). Timelines start at three business days for a Starter site. Maintenance plans start at $75 per month (Basic) and $250 per month (Pro).

Contact: Preston Winters. Phone (541) 551-0731. Email preston@winterscode.com. Based in Bandon, Oregon. Service area: Bandon, Coos Bay, North Bend, Coquille, Reedsport, Myrtle Point, Port Orford, and Gold Beach.

## Services
- [Web Design](https://winterscode.com/services/web-design): Custom marketing websites for small businesses.
- [Web Development](https://winterscode.com/services/web-development): Web apps and custom site builds.
- [App Development](https://winterscode.com/services/app-development): iOS and Android apps in Flutter.
- [Custom Software](https://winterscode.com/services/custom-software): Tools built for a specific business need.
- [AI Automation](https://winterscode.com/services/ai-automation): AI workflows and assistants for small teams.
- [SEO and Performance](https://winterscode.com/services/seo-performance): Speed and search work for existing sites.
- [Website Maintenance](https://winterscode.com/website-maintenance): Ongoing care plans, Basic from $75/mo and Pro from $250/mo.
- [Logo Design](https://winterscode.com/logo-design): Brand marks and identity.
- [Website Redesign](https://winterscode.com/website-redesign): Rebuilds of dated or slow sites.
